content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps on the central harassment claim. Complainant gave the EEO Investigator and AJ a list of 15 people allegedly involved and named specific documents (travel vouchers, field intelligence reports, requests for information, an Administrator's Audit Report on email monitoring). The record shows only an OPR Bluebook report with 9 interviews, all denials, and no sign that the EEO investigation or discovery obtained those documents or interviewed the other named witnesses. The Administrator's Audit Report could directly confirm or refute the email monitoring, yet it appears unpursued. The FAD rests on OPR's \"unfounded\" finding and Complainant's lack of proof, which is circular when the proof was left uncollected. The nonselection claims also lack selecting-official statements, selectee and comparator information, and any record of how selections were made. The Division Chief's account (transfer facilitated June 1, before EEO contact) conflicts with Complainant's account and the timeline is unresolved, as are the reprisal comment and the dismissed claim. A decision on the merits should wait until these gaps are filled."}
